start.title: Into the Temple
start.text:
You enter the temple courts with Jesus.
His eyes are steady.

choices.text: Wait outside, away from trouble
choices.feedback: Do not turn away from the holy.

choices.text: Walk in beside him with reverence
Run ahead to shout warnings

wait_consequence.title: Come Inside
wait_consequence.text:
The holy place is not for hiding from.
Follow him.

choices.text: Walk in beside him with reverence

shout_consequence.title: Quiet First
shout_consequence.text:
Loud words come before listening.
Be still.

choices.text: Walk in beside him with reverence

see_market.title: A House of Trade
see_market.text:
Tables of coin. Cages of doves.
The holy court has become a market.

choices.text: Shrug — "This is how it is."
choices.feedback: Do not bless what is broken.

choices.text: Buy a dove to fit in
Feel the wrongness with him

shrug_consequence.title: It Is Not Right
shrug_consequence.text:
What is wrong is not made right by time.
Look again.

choices.text: Feel the wrongness with him

buy_consequence.title: Not for Sale
buy_consequence.text:
Worship is not bought.
Set the coin down.

choices.text: Feel the wrongness with him
choices.feedback: You step away from the table.

cord.title: He Lifts the Cord
cord.text:
He weaves a cord of small ropes.
His purpose is clear.

choices.text: Stop him — "Do not cause trouble."
Stand near him, ready to follow

stop_consequence.title: Let Him Act
stop_consequence.text:
What looks like trouble is justice waking.
Stand with him.

choices.text: Stand near him, ready to follow

tables.title: Tables Overturned
tables.text:
Tables tip. Coins ring on stone.
The air shakes with holy fire.

choices.text: Grab coins for yourself in the chaos
Help clear the path for him
Cover your ears and look away

grab_consequence.title: Drop the Coin
grab_consequence.text:
You become what is being driven out.
Let it fall.

choices.text: Help clear the path for him

cover_consequence.title: Open Your Eyes
cover_consequence.text:
Witness what holiness costs.
Do not look away.

choices.text: Help clear the path for him

drive_out.title: Out You Go
drive_out.text:
Merchants hurry away with their cages.
Doves rise into open air.

choices.text: Mock them as they retreat
Open the cages, set doves free

mock_consequence.title: Without Scorn
mock_consequence.text:
Cleansing is not contempt.
Do good instead.

choices.text: Open the cages, set doves free

proclaim.title: A House of Prayer
proclaim.text:
"My house shall be called
a house of prayer."

choices.text: Argue that trade pays for repairs
Receive his words into your heart

argue_consequence.title: Holiness First
argue_consequence.text:
What is sacred cannot be sold for upkeep.
Listen again.

choices.text: Receive his words into your heart

disciples.title: They Remember
disciples.text:
The disciples watch and remember:
"Zeal for your house consumes him."

choices.text: Boast that you saw it first
Stand quietly, take it in

boast_consequence.title: Be Humble
boast_consequence.text:
Awe is louder than boasting.
Be still.

choices.text: Stand quietly, take it in

restored.title: Sacred Space
restored.text:
Dust settles. Light returns.
The court breathes again.

choices.text: Refill the tables when he leaves
choices.feedback: Do not rebuild what he tore down.

choices.text: Pray here as it was meant

refill_consequence.title: Keep It Clean
refill_consequence.text:
What was cleansed must stay clean.
Let it be holy.

choices.text: Pray here as it was meant

ending.title: Holy Ground
ending.text:
Where corruption was loud,
prayer rises, quiet and bright.
